subject: Shallow Depth Reported - Trois-Rivières to Donnacona - Cap Santé
text:
Shallow Depth Reported - Trois-Rivières to Donnacona - Cap Santé
Channel obstruction due to the presence of shoals reducing the advertised maintained depth to 10.1 metres at certain positions from a line between buoys Q54 and Q53 up to a distance of three (3) cable lengths upstream of this line.
